description: Return a list of US ZIP code suggestions for partial input, each with state (and optionally ZIP+4). Use for ZIP-field type-ahead or to expand a partial ZIP. For city suggestions use sthan_autocomplete_city; for full addresses use sthan_autocomplete_address. Read-only with no side effects. Requires a sthan.io API key in STHAN_API_KEY; each call counts toward your plan's rate limit (a free tier is available). On failure it returns an error message.
name: sthan_autocomplete_zipcode
title: Autocomplete US ZIP Code
